title: A Picture Like a Hug
originalStory: My little arrow badge glowed when I saw Mina sitting alone with her crayons. I sat beside her and drew a yellow sun, and the arrow curled into a tiny heart. Mina added a rainbow, and our picture felt like a hug.
visualBible:
Ellis: human child, age 5, normal human ears, short curly dark-brown hair, warm brown skin, mustard-yellow shirt with a soft sewn-on teal arrow badge, blue trousers, white shoes, small child-sized build.
Mina: human child, age 5, normal human ears, straight black bobbed hair, light brown skin, lavender dress over green leggings, purple shoes, small child-sized build.

pages.text: My little arrow badge glowed when I saw Mina sitting alone with her crayons. There was a whole white page in front of her, but not one mark. “Would you like some company?” I asked.
pages.illustrationScene: Pastel illustration in a welcoming playroom, with a wide view from the soft rug to the art corner. Ellis, recognizable by short curly dark-brown hair, a mustard-yellow shirt, and blue trousers, stands on the rug with a softly glowing sewn-on teal arrow badge. Across the room, Mina, recognizable by a straight black bob, a lavender dress, and green leggings, sits at a low, rounded art table with large crayons and blank paper, looking toward Ellis. Only Ellis and Mina are visible; the mood is quiet and hopeful.

pages.text: Mina nodded, and I sat beside her at the little table. “Maybe a sun could start us off,” I said, drawing a big yellow circle with wobbly rays. My arrow curled into a tiny heart.
pages.illustrationScene: Pastel close view of the low, rounded table in the playroom’s art corner. Ellis, with short curly dark-brown hair, a mustard-yellow shirt, and blue trousers, sits beside Mina and draws a yellow sun with a large crayon. The soft sewn-on badge on Ellis’s shirt now shows a tiny glowing teal heart. Mina, with a straight black bob, a lavender dress, and green leggings, watches the wobbly sun rays with a small smile. Only Ellis and Mina are visible; the mood is gently companionable.

pages.text: “My sun needs a rainbow,” Mina said, reaching for the purple crayon. She drew bright bands that stretched right over my wobbly rays. Now our picture had room for both our colors.
pages.illustrationScene: Pastel overhead still life focused entirely on the shared picture resting on the low art table. A big yellow sun with charmingly wobbly rays sits beneath a rainbow of broad crayon bands, including a fresh purple band. Large yellow and purple crayons rest beside the paper, with a few other large crayons nearby. No characters or body parts are visible. The mood is bright and tender, celebrating the finished drawing.

pages.text: We carried our picture to the reading nook and settled side by side on the soft rug. “It feels like a hug,” Mina whispered, holding one edge while I held the other. My tiny heart glowed, but the warmest bit was Mina’s shoulder resting beside mine.
pages.illustrationScene: Pastel illustration in a cozy reading nook with floor-level cushions and a low basket of picture books. Ellis, with short curly dark-brown hair, a mustard-yellow shirt, blue trousers, and a softly glowing teal heart badge, sits on the rug shoulder to shoulder with Mina, who has a straight black bob, a lavender dress, and green leggings. Ellis and Mina each hold one edge of their shared yellow-sun-and-rainbow drawing, looking at it with quiet smiles. Only Ellis and Mina are visible; the mood is safe, snug, and full of belonging.
